title: saturating
description: The backward-facing nucleus of an aperiodic settling: applies the saturation nucleus sigma_t to an element of a settled fiber Heyting algebra, returning the largest element whose restriction profile across all proper sub-histories matches it. Generates the saturating-nuclear-dyad-category.

morphism.description: a one-way generative arrow; the past-facing closure that saturates a settled fiber element against its restriction profile over every shorter history

domain.description: an aperiodic settling - the non-stabilizing regime whose history-graded fibers admit the saturation nucleus

codomain.description: the saturating-nuclear-dyad-category - Heyting algebras with a single nucleus sigma, each free carrier reflected onto its sub-history-determined fixed layer
